description:
We open up businesses to find what keeps them alive — and what kills them.

Every Cashflow Autopsy is a case file: the real startup costs, the margins, the hidden money, and who actually profits — from car washes and franchises to dental clinics and the private equity deals behind them. Every number is verified from company filings, government data or industry research.

Subscribe for new cases every week.

Educational only. Not financial advice. Narration uses an AI voice; all research, graphics and music are original to this channel.
